violation_type.title: Director Responsibilities - Employees Comply with Standards (26 TAC §744.1005(a)(2))
violation_type.short_title: Director Responsibilities - Employees Comply with Standards
violation_type.typical_finding: A caregiver and the operation director both left children unattended on the van. The director did not ensure compliance with minimum standards.

finding_variants.text: A caregiver and the operation director both left children unattended on the van. The director did not ensure compliance with minimum standards.
The program director is not ensuring that the site director and caregivers are following the minimum standards.
Based on observations during this inspection, the one staff person does not have a clear knowlege of minimum standard rules.
